title: Accounting Act (regnskapsloven, LOV-1998-07-17-56), chapter 2 sustainability reporting (§§ 2-3 to 2-9)

evidence: Lovdata page of LOV-2024-06-21-42, footnote 1: "Fra 1. november 2024 for del I (endringene i regnskapsloven), ... iflg. res. 11 okt 2024 nr. 2454." The § 2-3 note on the regnskapsloven page reads "Tilføyd ved lov 21 juni 2024 nr. 42 (i kraft 1 nov 2024 iflg. res. 11 okt 2024 nr. 2454)" (summarised, not verbatim). § 2-3 heading: "Plikt til å utarbeide bærekraftsrapportering". notes: Date is when chapter 2 sustainability reporting was added; the Act itself dates from 1999-01-01 ("Ikrafttredelse 01.01.1999"). § 2-5 was later changed by lov 10 april 2025 nr. 11 (in force 2025-08-01).
